Form L · Lost property

Tell us what went missing.

Give a finder enough to recognise it, keep one identifier back for yourself, and the desk will score every found item against it.

✦ ✧

Your details are secure and only visible to admin.

What happens next

  1. The desk checks the report before it goes on the counter.
  2. The private detail stays hidden and is used only to verify a finder.
  3. Once published, every found item is scored against your report and the close ones appear under Matches.
Help us keep the community safe

Accurate reports help return more items to the right owners.

Form F · Found property

You found it. Now log it.

Found reports enter the admin queue and stay off the public counter until they are approved.

✦ ✧

Safe posting

  1. Never show full document numbers or private contact details.
  2. Keep one unique feature off the public listing.
  3. Wait for approval before arranging any handover.
